m_Description: Vampires burn in the sun. Hide under a roof before dawn.
A blood transfusion of at least 250 ml cures the bitten, if it comes before the fever runs out.
Hungry vampires hear your heartbeat. Silence will not hide you.
A fed vampire looks human. Red eyes and fangs mean that one is hungry.
Bite marks, fever and coughing: find a blood bag before the sickness turns you.
Vampires cannot keep human food down. Watch who refuses to eat.
At night, gunfire can leave vampires down but alive. Finish them with a stake.
